name: Origami
summary: One sheet of paper folds through the whole story; the anomaly is printed in coral on the inside of a peek fold.
look: White paper with crisp creases and faceted shading on a pale sage ground, printed in teal ink. Coral appears only on inner faces of folds.

components.name: Fold panel
components.role: a plane that rotates on its hinge edge with backface hidden; the unit of every transition

components.name: Crease line
components.role: dashed hairline that appears 4 frames before a fold — the visual count-in

components.name: Facet shade
components.role: panel fill darkens with its fold angle, giving depth without 3D

components.name: Inner face
components.role: the coral back side of a fold; the only place the anomaly colour appears

components.name: Blintz flaps
components.role: four triangles that open around the centre square for the logo reveal

components.name: Dog-ear button
components.role: paper tag with a folded corner used for “Roll back” and “Start free”

motion.name: Accordion unfold
motion.how: each panel rotates 180→0°, power3.inOut 0.45 s, staggered by 0.25 s (an eighth note at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Crease pre-flash
motion.how: 4-frame dashed line + 2° pre-bend before every fold, so the eye knows where the paper will break before the beat

motion.name: Peek fold
motion.how: rotateY 0 → 30°, expo.out 0.3 s, hold 1 s (2 beats), then complete to 180° on the next downbeat

story: Hook: a fanfold of printed dashboards unfurls under “How many dashboards did you check today?”. Reveal: four blintz flaps spring open on the drop around the Acme mark and “Acme Pulse”. Proof: a tri-fold of calm metrics peeks open 30° to show the coral inner face “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231”; the human picks the “Roll back” tag. CTA: the sheet refolds into an envelope sealed with the mark — “Every metric. Every minute.” — and “Start free”.
adapt: Print your product's key screen onto the sheet and pick the one thing it surfaces as the inner face; any list-type UI (orders, tickets, builds) folds naturally into a tri-fold or accordion.

fit.risk: Diagonal CSS-3D folds are fiddly; plan every hinge edge and keep copy on camera-facing panels.
